item.title: Kevin Herbst Announced as Area Managing Director for Emeline & The Ryder Hotel
item.description: Emeline and The Ryder Hotel, part of the Makeready collection, are pleased to announce the appointment of Kevin Herbst as Area Managing Director

item.title: Why Valentine’s Day Feels So Lonely for Charleston Singles—and What We’re Getting Wrong About Love
item.description: Valentine’s Day has a way of magnifying emotions, especially for singles.

item.title: Johns Island County Park to host Toast Under the Oaks March 12 and April 2
item.description: Come enjoy live music, tasty beverages and beautiful scenery during Toast under the Oaks at Johns Island County Park this spring! This year’s events will be held on Thursday, March 12 and Thursday, April 2, from 5:30 – 7:30 p.m. each day.

item.title: Sustain SC Welcomes Two New Team Members, Brent Kossick and Megan Dix
item.description: Sustain SC is thrilled to announce the addition of two new team members, Brent Kossick as the Director of Partnerships, and Megan Dix as the Marketing and Events Coordinator.

item.title: Live Oak Charleston Hotel to Open on Historic Meeting Street in April 2026
item.description: Live Oak Charleston, a new lifestyle hotel rooted in wellness, design, and a strong sense of place, is slated to open in April 2026 on Meeting Street in downtown Charleston.

item.title: What’s Next at IAAM: Celebrating Black History Month
item.description: Having recently surpassed the historic milestone of over 500,000 visitors since its grand opening, June 2023, the International African American Museum (IAAM) continues to make its impact as a global destination

item.title: DECOY, New Neighborhood Bar from Dog & Duck, Opening Mid-February
item.description: DECOY, a neighborhood bar concept brought to life by the team behind Dog & Duck Family Pubs, is set to open in mid-February at the corner of Highway 41 and Highway 17, in the space formerly known as The Basement.

item.title: MOJA Arts Festival Celebrates Black History Month with February Performances at Dock Street Theatre
item.description: As part of its 41st anniversary season, the MOJA Arts Festival will honor Black History Month with two powerful February events at the Dock Street Theatre, celebrating Black artistry, cultural legacy, and future vision

item.title: Salthouse Catering opens commissary kitchen space to support Charleston food entrepreneurs
item.description: Salthouse Catering announced the launch of Salthouse Commissary Kitchen, a newly updated, purpose-built culinary space located adjacent to its existing operation.

item.title: "Nectar Collector," solo exhibition by Melanie Parke, opens in March at Meyer Vogl Gallery
item.description: Meyer Vogl Gallery is pleased to announce Nectar Collector, a solo exhibition by Melanie Parke, opening in March 2026.
